purpose: Preserve the full VexArchitecture alignment intention as a constrained refactor map: meaning remains with rightful owners, relationships are authored once and consumed rather than reconstructed, identities derive from existing source structure, construction is explicit, connective layers contribute mechanics without acquiring peer semantics, generated consequences are derived, invalid relationships fail at the rightful boundary, and held closure remains visibly owed until reconciled.

laws.statement: Meaning stays with the smallest owner that can answer the semantic/domain question; connective, projection, provider and execution layers must not grow peer vocabularies that restate that meaning.
antiPatterns: peer wrapper object restates an existing owner API
projection-specific vocabulary pushed upstream into semantic source
provider or execution mechanics decide Work meaning

laws.statement: A relationship is authored once at its rightful source and downstream consumers receive that relationship or its bounded projection rather than reconstructing it from names, strings, counts, comments or convention.
antiPatterns: consumer retypes stable identity from a string convention
second registry manually repeats a relationship derivable from source
prose TODO is the only carrier of an owed relationship

laws.statement: When identity already exists in authored structure, reuse or derive from that structure before minting a parallel key, token, correlation coordinate or alias.
antiPatterns: new identity layer introduced only to connect two already-related objects
provider/path/count used as semantic identity by convenience
duplicate currentness identity for the same Work/Project relationship

laws.statement: Construction and prerequisites remain source-readable and bounded; consumers receive concrete relationships and may not discover hidden dependencies through ambient lookup, reflection-like inference or repository archaeology.
antiPatterns: service-locator-style hidden lookup
relationship discovery by scanning naming conventions
future worker must search chat/history to know a prerequisite

laws.statement: Composition, integration, runtime, provider and execution layers contribute only the mechanics they rightfully own; they consume already-authored meaning and do not create a parallel feature/work vocabulary.
antiPatterns: Integration Steward becomes a WorkState owner
generated projection becomes an authoring owner
coordination claim becomes semantic Project meaning

laws.statement: Current semantic truth, historical chronology/evidence and human/debug projections remain distinct owners; one may reference another without becoming its truth source.
antiPatterns: provider timestamp treated as Work currentness
VexBoard becomes Work truth
historical checkpoint treated as present authority

laws.statement: A deterministic consequence of authoritative source is generated or checked from that source; it is not maintained as an independent handwritten truth that future workers must remember to synchronize.
antiPatterns: hand-edit generated aggregate as ordinary semantic source
hard-coded population count used as architecture
source and projection can drift while checks remain green

laws.statement: An invalid or incomplete relationship fails where it can be proven invalid; downstream readers/renderers/integrators must not silently repair, guess or normalize away the source defect.
antiPatterns: renderer guesses missing semantic relationship
integration silently drops unresolved source
validator checks only members already present and misses source-set closure

laws.statement: When a required relationship cannot yet converge lawfully, the exact unsatisfied relationship and predicate remain structurally observable until evidence clears them; a temporary hold must not decay into invisible future work.
antiPatterns: do it later lives only in PR prose
shared-path conflict causes a required consequence to disappear
absence from projection is mistaken for absence of Work

laws.statement: Proof is bound to the exact relationship claim and owner; a green structural check, provider observation, generated file, UI rendering or human screenshot cannot silently prove a different layer.
antiPatterns: green registry syntax proves discoverability closure
merge proves lived navigation
UI visibility proves canonical source currentness

relationships.constraint: Every source segment participates in deterministic composition; the checked-in canonical Workgraph must equal the composition result.
Every Project rootWorkRef must resolve in the bound canonical Workgraph and select only canonical Work descendants.

Bounded source enumeration may discover candidate Project definitions, but path/slug is not Project identity. Each candidate must supply a validated projectRef; its Board must bind that same projectRef; its roots must resolve in exactly one admitted canonical Workgraph relationship (or fail/hold on ambiguity); every eligible Project must then appear exactly once in discoverability and no orphan registry entry may exist.
Public workspace is a deterministic consequence of current canonical Project + Workgraph truth and cannot remain green while those source relationships are omitted or stale.

After accepted source movement, deterministic VexWork consequences are re-derived and verified at the rightful convergence boundary; source lanes do not permanently own generated aggregate synchronization.

A required but temporarily unresolvable relationship remains visible with its exact predicate/evidence until convergence; clearing evidence removes the attention without changing WorkState by implication.
Evidence currentness is derived without becoming WorkState or transition authority.
Process routing remains source-addressable navigation and never becomes hidden execution or authority.
VexBoard receives already-owned identities/relationships and must not force VexWork to mint projection-specific semantic IDs or acquire healing/lifecycle authority.

Project identity plus canonical Work Registry lanes must be sufficient to derive the default Board view; an explicit Board-view source is required only for independently meaningful Project-specific view configuration and must bind the same projectRef rather than restating canonical defaults by convention.

sourceClassifications.reason: The Work lifecycle grammar, classes, authority/effect dispositions and Board-lane coverage are intentionally authored VexWork semantics; they are not consequences of enumerating Work items.
Repository admission, external identity, entry routes and culture references are intentional cross-repository relations and cannot be truthfully derived from the VexWork filesystem alone.
A reusable process is deliberately admitted and may be owned by another repository; file presence does not imply process admission or VexWork navigation.
Planning event classes and non-collapse laws define portable planning meaning rather than enumerating current Project instances.
Reconciliation dispositions and provider/proof vocabulary define a bounded interpretation contract rather than restating current provider observations.

Graph identity, canonical sourceRefs and compatibility ordering are explicit composition/migration policy; current segment membership itself is source-derived from workgraphs/segments/*.json and must not be duplicated here.

For source-managed local Projects, definition path, Board path, stable ProjectRef and ordinary shared Workgraph relation are substantially derivable from project-local source; current manual membership is the observed omission/synchronization pressure.
Accepted Workgraph Composition already defines this as the deterministic canonical value generated from segment source plus composition policy.
The public workspace is deterministically built from Project discoverability, Project definitions, Board views and canonical Workgraph truth.
The dashboard is a checked-in read projection built from Foundation Project/Board/Parking Lot truth and has no independent semantic authority.

All 18 current Project Board views repeat the exact canonical laneRefOrder owned by the Work Registry. Default Board projection should be derivable from Project identity + canonical lane semantics; an explicit Board-view source should remain available only when a Project earns independently meaningful view configuration.

foundationAlignments.note: Work identity/lifecycle/containment/dependency and transition legality have one canonical owner; transition requests revalidate exact-current truth.
Direct test ownership, source-only coverage floors and review distinguish regression evidence from semantic clearance.
Segment membership is source-derived and the canonical public Workgraph is deterministic consequence; compatibility order is policy rather than membership.
Project definitions are rightful source, but discoverability membership and default Board-view restatement remain manually synchronized and can omit valid Projects.
Handshake binds exact Project/Workgraph/state/proposal fingerprints and cannot create authority; stewardship mechanics do not replace lifecycle truth.
Projection ownership is sound, but all 18 current board.view sources repeat the same canonical lane order and have not earned independent default-view authoring.
Population/evidence interpretation stays read-only and cannot become WorkState or effect authority.
One exact derived concern crosses into Work only through explicit bound proposal/decision/application; attention does not auto-create Work.
Descriptor binds external owners without copying their records or stealing execution/source authority.
Current ATTENTION/UNKNOWN/CLEAR observations are separate from WorkState; explicit CLEAR evidence is already a useful pattern for held-closure visibility.
PARKED is Work disposition projected separately from Project membership/lifecycle.
Reusable process admission is explicit cross-owner navigation and carries no execution authority.
Repository relations intentionally admit external identities/entry routes; they cannot be inferred from local files without erasing cross-repository decisions.
Provider records remain provenance/observations rather than Work identity or lifecycle truth.
Workgraph transitions remain the semantic event ledger; immutable snapshots/pointer lineage supply currentness mechanics without a second lifecycle history.
Participation answers a genuinely different history question using participant/continuity/session/engagement coordinates without becoming assignment, WorkState or authority.
Execution substrate changes effect route, not Work semantics or authority.
Current source is durable; predecessor interpretation is deliberately not another truth owner.
Planning events/currentness are independently meaningful planning truth and explicitly do not become WorkState.
Provider/proof evidence is joined into deterministic disposition without transition authority.
Current integration correctly separates candidate proof from merge/currentness, but accepted VexWork source can still leave deterministic aggregate consequences stale or held only in prose.
UI is correctly read-only, but its lived completeness inherits stale workspace/discoverability consequences until A1-A4 close those relationships.

demonstrations.relationship: Independent Work families author their own segment once; composition discovers segment membership, validates ownership/identity, and deterministically produces workgraphs/public.json rather than requiring each lane to restate aggregate membership.
demonstrations.visibleConsequence: Adding a valid source segment changes the canonical composition input automatically; duplicate Work ownership, graph mismatch, foreign containment or stale checked-in aggregate fail closed.
demonstrations.notThis: A generic registry framework or permission for generated public Workgraph source to become a second semantic author.

demonstrations.relationship: Workgraph transitions remain the semantic lifecycle/event owner while runtime persistence contributes immutable snapshot/pointer-lineage currentness mechanics and delegates transitions back to requestTransition(...).
demonstrations.visibleConsequence: A persisted snapshot does not become current by existence, a pointer is not WorkState, stale writer/currentness inputs fail closed, and no second runtime lifecycle event ontology is minted.
demonstrations.notThis: Duplicating Work transition history into a runtime status ledger.

demonstrations.relationship: Project + canonical Workgraph truth, provider observation and proof observation are joined into a deterministic reconciliation disposition without making provider/proof state canonical WorkState or granting transition authority.
demonstrations.visibleConsequence: Merged provider state or green checks cannot silently complete Work; stale/unknown evidence produces its own bounded disposition.

demonstrations.relationship: Processes and repositories are deliberately admitted through explicit source-readable declarations; consumers receive stable refs and owner entry routes rather than discovering meaning from folder/package/provider convention.
demonstrations.visibleConsequence: Unknown repository/process refs fail closed and cross-repository references preserve navigation without transferring source or execution authority.
demonstrations.notThis: Filesystem scanning, naming convention or ambient provider lookup as institutional identity.

demonstrations.relationship: A phase proposal carries the exact existing Project, WorkRef, Workgraph fingerprint, WorkState and policy boundary through human response and AI confirmation rather than inventing a parallel approval identity that can float onto changed work.
demonstrations.visibleConsequence: A stale proposal/response cannot be applied to a changed Workgraph, and approval cannot create authority that the Work item did not already have.
demonstrations.notThis: A second lifecycle, generic approval token or human acknowledgement as authority.

demonstrations.relationship: Current source/provider evidence may become read-only attention without automatically becoming Work; explicit promotion is a separate exact-bound relationship when durable Work is actually earned.
demonstrations.visibleConsequence: ATTENTION/UNKNOWN/CLEAR can change with evidence while WorkState remains untouched; an exact concern can later create or confirm one Work item through a separate proposal/decision boundary.
demonstrations.notThis: Ticket-per-observation automation or attention as another lifecycle.

demonstrations.relationship: This Project carries the full intention in one source contract, binds every migration relationship to a real Work item, records the A0 deterministic proof absence as WAITING_TOOL rather than prose-only debt, and binds the exact current Relay proof inputs without pretending stage binding is execution.
demonstrations.visibleConsequence: A fresh instance can descend Project -> contract -> current Work -> held predicate -> exact proof route without reconstructing the predecessor chat, while A1 remains dependency-held.
demonstrations.notThis: A claim that the Project-local alignment contract is VexWork's permanent runtime ontology.

demonstrations.relationship: Project-local source and a Workgraph segment can be accepted while independently required relationships remain incomplete: the patient-zero segment omitted required segment-level sourceRefs/formedAt, and a separately hand-maintained discoverability registry/public projection omitted the same Project.
demonstrations.visibleConsequence: The accepted patient-zero source failed the canonical Workgraph Segment source-census contract and the VexWork Projects navigation surface still could not reach it; temporary/incomplete relationship closure survived because separate consequences were not constrained together.
demonstrations.notThis: Evidence that the New Beginnings Work items or VexLife-Prod product semantics are invalid; the defects are missing VexWork relationship/provenance closure.

demonstrations.relationship: All 18 current Project Board-view files restate the same laneRefOrder already canonically owned by the Work Registry.
demonstrations.visibleConsequence: Every new Project currently creates another synchronization surface even when it has no Project-specific view semantics.
demonstrations.notThis: A claim that custom Project views or Board projection are unnecessary.

demonstrations.relationship: The normal VexWork orientation route explicitly exposes the active architecture-evolution Project when VexWork itself is implicated, while labeling the Project as candidate/evolution source rather than accepted Foundation authority.
demonstrations.visibleConsequence: A fresh human or agent can discover the Alignment Project from the same Foundation Index/orientation surfaces they already read, without knowing PR #210, the Project slug in advance, or relying on the currently incomplete public Project Registry projection.
demonstrations.notThis: Project Registry acceptance, Foundation acceptance, merge clearance, or permission for candidate architecture to override accepted Foundation source.
